description: Eight voltage knobs with sixteen memory slots, recalled by a button, a trigger or a voltage

params.text: Stores the eight knob settings into the slot shown on the display and marks that slot as used
Loads the slot shown on the display back into the eight knobs
Steps the display to the next slot, without loading anything
Steps the display to the previous slot, without loading anything
Loads the next slot that has something stored in it
Loads the previous slot that has something stored in it
Loads a stored slot at random, choosing the next or the previous one by a coin toss
Sets the voltage on that row, -10V to 10V, and is what a save writes into the slot

inputs.text: Picks the slot by voltage, one slot per volt from 1V, and loads it the moment the voltage changes
A rising edge here loads a stored slot at random, choosing the next or the previous one by a coin toss
A rising edge here loads the previous slot that has something stored in it
A rising edge here loads the next slot that has something stored in it

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of the knob on that row

notes: the slot buttons do nothing until something has been stored: press Save to fill the slot on the display, and the small green lamp lights for a slot that has been filled
the two-digit display shows the slot number, 1 to 16
menu: Polyphonic — puts all eight voltages on the first output as eight channels, and leaves the other seven outputs holding whatever they last carried
Monophonic — puts each voltage on its own output, and is the setting the module comes up in

inputs.0:
1 to 8V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
